location.source: Theorems 1.3 and 13.2, continuous proof, Appendix A

findings.claim: A nonnegative shear norm is an injective linear combination of arbitrary real amplitudes.
findings.check: k=1, lambda=-epsilon<0, scalar amplitude zero, v>0 and omega in the specified positive ball give negative RHS and nonnegative norm. Epsilon can be arbitrarily small.
assumptions_verified: Positive nonzero fi on specified ball
Both BV and continuous g(v)>0 profiles
findings.counterevidence: Appendix A has signed scalar conformal free datum x', not signed norm.

repair.statement: Parameterize conformal metric or actual shear tensor; norm equals abs(sum lambda_i fi).
repair.verified: det m=1, norm squared=a(x')^2; symmetric log and disjoint supports recover amplitudes from full free data. Characteristic constraint/evolution hypotheses still required.

findings.impact: Literal arbitrary-dimensional family in Theorems 1.3/13.2 false; valid-data horizon mechanism not refuted.

independent_verification.source_claim_check: The actual Theorems1.3/13.2 prescribe a shear norm as a signed sum for arbitrary real nonzero parameter vectors; the proof supplies positive fi on disjoint balls, also in the continuous g(v)>0 version.
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: k=1, lambda1=-epsilon and scalar amplitude0 satisfy the nonzero condition for arbitrarily small epsilon. On the specified ball at v>0 the prescribed RHS is negative, whereas the norm of a tensor for a positive sphere metric cannot be negative. This fails already at data realizability, without requiring existence of an Einstein development.
independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: AppendixA instead supplies a signed scalar in a conformal matrix. For m=exp(sqrt(2a)x diag(1,-1)), detm=1 and tr((m^-1m')^2)/4=a(x')^2. Hence the corrected norm is abs(sum lambda_i fi). Symmetric logarithm with fixed initial x and disjoint supports recovers the full free-data amplitudes, not their signs from the norm alone. Constraint/evolution hypotheses remain unproved by this algebraic repair.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: The literal core arbitrary-dimensional instability family cannot be prescribed as stated; retain Major without denying the horizon mechanism for valid data.

location.source: Proposition 12.4 and (12.5); compare introductory metric and (9.13)

findings.claim: The induced horizon metric has cross 2RA and vertical 4Rv; stated lower barrier implies positivity.
findings.check: Exact pullback gives cross 2Omega^2 RA-hAB dB, vertical 4Omega^2 Rv+hAB dA dB. Schur complement 4Omega^2(Rv+d.Rgrad-Omega^2|grad_h R|^2). Printed psi lower bound reverses (9.13).
assumptions_verified: Shift-free diagnostic independent of eq2.1 coordinate typo
findings.counterevidence: Rv positive; lapse suppresses gradient correction; torsion controls shift. No timelike-MOTS counterexample.

repair.statement: Use exact Schur complement, lower psi=exp(-mu*kappabar), and torsion shift bound.
repair.verified: For fixed parameters, gradient/Rv=O(v^(2mu)); shift/Rv=O(v^(3mu)), O(v^2 log(1/v)), or O(v^2). Gives positivity for small v under preceding estimates.

findings.impact: Printed proof of central spacelikeness invalid but local correction supported. General achronality relying on external [7] not reproved.

independent_verification.source_claim_check: The introductory metric and null frame fix lapse Omega and angular shift d. The actual p81 coordinate-basis induced metric omits their factors; the lower bound for psi reverses the barrier from(9.13).
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: The graph u=-R has g'AB=hAB, g'Av=2Omega^2 RA-hAB dB, g'vv=4Omega^2 Rv+hAB dA dB. Its Schur complement is 4Omega^2(Rv+d.Rgrad-Omega^2|grad_hR|^2). The auxiliary independently recomputed the exact full matrix pullback and zero difference of this Schur expression; a shift-free diagnostic already distinguishes the printed formula.
independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: Correct psi lower bound is exp(-mu*kappabar). For fixed mu,a and positive barriers, R~v^(1-mu), Rv>=cR/v and Omega^2~R^(mu/(1-mu)) give gradient/Rv=O(v^(2mu)). The actual torsion relation partial_u d=4Omega^2 zeta and initial shift0 give shift/Rv respectively O(v^(3mu)), O(v^2 log(1/v)), O(v^2). Thus corrected positivity holds sufficiently near v0 under the prior geometric estimates. No uniformity as parameters degenerate or replacement for external achronality is claimed.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: The original calculation proves positivity of a different quadratic form, affecting central spacelikeness. Retain Major for that derivation defect; positive Rv and the supported fixed-parameter repair prevent claiming a timelike-MOTS counterexample.

findings.check: At prescribed v=0 background norm is 4sqrt(pi)(1-mu) r^(mu/(1-mu))>0; RHS zero.

repair.verified: Weighted integral (1-r^k)/k finite for fixed mu, compatible with O(sqrt(a)) target a>=1.

findings.impact: Local false estimate; no demonstrated failure of corrected core argument.

independent_verification.source_claim_check: The second inequality of Proposition4.3 explicitly includes derivative order0 without background subtraction.
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: For its prescribed v0 spherical background, Omega0^2=r^k and Omega^-1 trchi=2(1-mu)/r give L2 norm4sqrt(pi)(1-mu)r^k>0 at fixed r, whereas the asserted O(va/r) vanishes. The same contradiction follows by a bounded one-sided limit.

In the actual downstream scalar forcing the recovered background integrates as (1-r^k)/k, finite for fixed mu>0 and compatible with the O(sqrt(a)) target for a>=1. It must not be relabeled O(v).
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: A genuinely false local stronger bound, but the inspected corrected core estimates remain compatible; retain Minor.

independent_verification.source_claim_check: Section2.2 presents a universal local Einstein-scalar Weyl identity, rather than an identity restricted to the later special initial data. Its printed extreme equation contains the specified pure-trace matter term.
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: The exact FLRW metric -dt^2+t^(2/3)dx^2 and phi=sqrt(2/3)logt solve Ric=dphi^2 and the scalar wave equation with all Weyl components0. Native independent SymPy computation of all256 Weyl components and covariant Ricci derivatives yields the printed matter coefficient1/(3t^3), nonzero. Radial double-null coordinates eta=3t^(2/3)/2, u=(eta-rho)/2, v=(eta+rho)/2 give genuine spherical sections and g34=-2, so a plane-section objection does not exclude it.
independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: The inspected core energy equations use renormalized beta,K,sigma,betabar. No dependency on the false extreme evolution line was demonstrated. A complete STF equation must be rederived from(2.12), or the unused false line removed; simply discarding the trace is not certified as the full correction.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: Retain Minor for the false universal identity, without asserting a counterexample to the special-data main theorem or a formal complete PDE dependency audit.
